headline: Georgia Tech has opened its new Nexus AI supercomputer to scientists across the United States.
score_reason: Pool score 5 kept: useful access to research computing, but a modest, expected infrastructure step.
summary: Interesting Engineering reports that Georgia Tech has opened nationwide access to Nexus, an AI supercomputer built with $20 million from the National Science Foundation with the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign, which lets researchers run simulations, handle large datasets and build AI models on one platform. About 90 percent of its capacity will go to projects chosen through an open, peer-reviewed process run by the NSF.
importance_line: University researchers across the country, not only those at wealthy institutions, can apply for time on the machine, though demand and waiting times are not reported.
